name: Quest Tracker
description: Manages quest objectives, completion states, and rewards. Add the Agent in Chat Settings → Agents → Tracker Agents for Roleplay mode.
author: Pasta Devs

defaultSettings.defaultPromptTemplateDescription: Tracks narrative quests from the roleplay, capped at 3 active.

promptTemplates.name: Epic Campaign
promptTemplates.description: No active-quest cap; supports many concurrent, multi-stage questlines for long campaigns.

promptTemplates.name: Real-Life Goals
promptTemplates.description: Tracks real-world goals the user has said they want to do. With section injection on, the character can encourage them (breaks the fourth wall); turn injection off to keep the journal private.

promptTemplates.name: Single Focus
promptTemplates.description: Tracks exactly one quest at a time; when it resolves, the next one begins. Minimal and low-token.

promptTemplates.name: Mystery Board
promptTemplates.description: Investigation-focused: tracks cases with leads, clues, and suspects as objectives. Great for mystery and detective roleplay.

promptTemplates.name: Custom
promptTemplates.description: A starter you edit in agent settings. Replace the [YOUR INSTRUCTIONS] line with your own rules; keep the output format below so the tracker keeps working.
